messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 — kv-runtime (prod) reporting sustained continuous-batching growth + KV cache blowup for routing group 'qwen-mistral-llama-mix'. Symptoms: token-latency spike, GPU mem thrash, 3 high-volume tenants impacted. Pager routed to @oncall-amy.

oncall-amy: Ack, I'm on it. tagging @eng-sre-mira @infra-ben @ml-ryan

eng-sre-mira: Observing abnormal metric: `kv_cache.unique_prefixes_per_min` jumped ~6x across shards kv-05..kv-12. p95 latency for MQA requests climbed 120ms -> 980ms. Evictions and prefix churn high. Looks like prefetch + contbatch window growth interacting badly.

infra-ben: Host checks: `nvidia-smi` shows GPU memory oscillation, kernel restarts on pod kv-runtime-05. Grepped logs show repeated entries: `kv_cache: new_prefix detected 1.2M unique keys/min` — definitely not normal.

ml-ryan: We recently enabled a contbatch expansion for Qwen (prefix window -> 8k) and cross-model batching as an optimization. Hypothesis: Qwen tokenization + dedupe gap is producing many near-unique prefixes that prefetch then populate KV, causing explosion for mixed model routing (Qwen <-> Llama). GQA/MQA edge paths particularly sensitive.

oncall-amy: Proposed immediate plan: 1) rollback cross-model batching for qwen variants 2) throttle/disable prefetch on affected shards 3) apply targeted config change (canary -> staged rollout) to limit blast radius. I'll coordinate rollout.

eng-sre-mira: I'll prepare a canary config. Hotfix proposal: set `contbatch.max_window=2048` and `prefetch.enabled=false` for routing group `qwen-*` on affected shards, enable metric_export for deeper telemetry.

infra-ben: Applying to canary shard kv-05 now. Command I'm running: ```./deploy.sh --service kv-runtime --shard kv-05 --set contbatch.max_window=2048 prefetch.enabled=false```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy for kv-runtime (kv-05). SHA: a1b2c3d. Rolling 3 pods, health checks enabled.

eng-sre-mira: Canary metrics: p95 down 980ms -> ~200ms within 2m of change. `kv_cache.unique_prefixes_per_min` reduced from 1.2M -> ~42k. No OOMs, CPU stable. Looks promising.

oncall-amy: Good. Promoting to staged rollout across kv-06..kv-12 in waves of 2 shards. Notifying @se-jordan for customer comms.

se-jordan: Drafting customer note now. Short message for impacted tenants: "We observed transient latency increases due to an interaction between continuous-batching and KV prefetch on certain models. We've applied mitigations and latency has returned to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with details." Ready to send once we see staged rollout stability.

cust-ops-bot: Customer alert: delivered to tenants A123, B456. Support tickets created: 7890, 7891.

eng-sre-mira: Rolling wave 2: `rollout --service kv-runtime --shards=kv-06,kv-07 --parallel=2 --set contbatch.max_window=2048 prefetch.enabled=false` — wave complete, no regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave 2 complete. No rollbacks detected.

infra-ben: To avoid cascade autoscaling feedback, I've temporarily capped autoscale on affected pools and reduced prefetch scan concurrency. Watching latency/eviction metrics.

ml-ryan: As a preventative measure we'll blacklist cross-model batching for qwen->llama routing for 24h while we run replays and offline dedupe tests. Also adding unit tests around prefix hash collision scenarios.

oncall-amy: Status update: mitigated, severity downgraded to SEV4. Leaving bridge open for 45m. I'll file the post-incident writeup and hand off to eng-sre for RCA, and to product for config-guarding. Incident tracker: INC-2026-0423. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre-mira: Handoff notes for follow-up (short): root_cause hypothesis = interaction of expanded contbatch window + aggressive prefetch + tokenization idiosyncrasies in Qwen producing high cardinality prefixes and eviction churn across shards serving mixed model traffic. Immediate remediation = reduce contbatch window + disable prefetch for qwen routing group. Next actions: run synthetic replay with mixed qwen/llama prompts, add rollout guard against large contbatch window increases without targeted A/B on MQA/GQA traffic, instrument prefix dedupe counters, and schedule a design session to consider per-model prefetch profiles. I'll attach logs and deploy diffs to the incident doc.

oncall-amy: Thanks everyone. Handing to @eng-sre-mira for RCA and @ml-ryan for follow-up tests. If anything flares, ping this thread or call pager.
